scan_linter_check.description:
Flags getRowCount() on a GlideRecord whose rows are never iterated (no next()): the query loads every matching row just to count them. GlideAggregate counts in the database. Server-side scripts only.
Replaces the legacy check "NS: getRowCount() Instead of GlideAggregate" (priority 2), which also flagged getRowCount() used alongside reading the rows.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-GR-006: getRowCount() used to count records
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Count with GlideAggregate (addAggregate('COUNT') and getAggregate('COUNT')), which counts in the database instead of loading every row.
scan_linter_check.short_description: getRowCount() is called on a GlideRecord whose rows are never read.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-GR-006: getRowCount() used to count records
